coord. ref. : CGCS2000_Albers  ## source      : npp.tif  ## names       :      npp,        pre,      tem  ## min values  :   164.00,   384.3409, -47.8194  ## max values  : 16606.33, 23878.3555, 263.6938  terra::plot(npp,nc = 3,             mar = rep(0.1,4),             oma = rep(0.1,4),             axes = FALSE,             legend = FALSE) predRows = seq(10,terra::nrow(npp),10) predCols = seq(10,terra::ncol(npp),10) pred = as.matrix(merge(predRows,predCols)) startTime = Sys.time() npp_res = gccm(cause = "pre",                effect = "npp",                data = npp,                libsizes = seq(20,300,20),                E = 3,                RowCol = pred,                trendRM = TRUE) ##
